messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: This forum
parts:
Hi, folks. In a recent "thank-you" message, Teena stated the following:

> I love this forum!

I think a lot of people would agree with that sentiment, and it occurs
to me that we all owe a debt of gratitude to Noam (and his minions)
for working so hard to keep the meetings and the mailing list working
so well. Maybe others have said this already? In any event, here's
my contribution: thanks, Noam.

-- Mike
